title.narrative: Overall Objective: To pave the way for improvement in the conditions of indigenous women and youths in three regions in Guyana; the need to improve the conditions exacerbated by the COVID 19 pandemic, but that were always present, for them to be a part of the decision making process in community governance, and to engage in small livelihoods projects.

description.narrative: Overall Objective: To pave the way for improvement in the conditions of indigenous women and youths in three regions in Guyana; the need to improve the conditions exacerbated by the COVID 19 pandemic, but that were always present, for them to be a part of the decision making process in community governance, and to engage in small livelihoods projects.

title.narrative: 001. Indigenous women and youth in 3 regions of Guyana trained in understanding the main issued face by women and youth in their territories and devising women and youthled solutions to these issues. Training will include an understanding of the laws on rights of women and other legal avenues relevant to pursuing redress in the courts regarding domestic violence, sexual offences, teenage pregnancy among others. Small grant projects are designed and implemented.
